title: ancistrum elongatum
intro: Ancistrum elongatum, commonly known as the Elongated Ancistrocladus, is a plant species that belongs to the family Ancistrocladaceae. It is a woody vine native to Southeast Asia, particularly in the tropical forests of Indonesia and Malaysia. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, thanks to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Ancistrum elongatum include lignans and other phenolic compounds, which contribute to its potential medicinal and therapeutic actions.
